craft_notes: Sthāyin: body-cosmos (as above v41, inverse: body becomes directions). Rows: row 3 (undirected→proceeds). Close: through (sky as transmission). Rejected: 'imagine' — killed: contemplate kept; 'omnidirectional' — killed: all-directions kept plain.

lines: In own body all directions at once as sky:
undirected mind — of him sky proceeds all through.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nijadehe sarvadikkaṃ yugapad bhāvayed viyat | nirvikalpamanās tasya viyat sarvam pravartate

reads_against.argmap: Where is sky contemplated? → Undirected mind in own body makes sky proceed all through.
c1_essence: Own body as all directions: undirected mind, sky proceeds.
